scenarios.title: Basic Training
scenarios.description: Learn the fundamentals of driving in a controlled environment. Master acceleration, braking, and steering.

scenarios.title: Highway Merging
scenarios.description: Practice safe merging and lane changes at high speed on a simulated highway.

scenarios.title: Night Driving
scenarios.description: Sharpen your depth perception and headlight discipline in low-visibility conditions.

scenarios.title: Wet Weather Handling
scenarios.description: Master braking distances and skid control on rain-slicked roads with reduced traction.

scenarios.title: Tight Reverse Parking
scenarios.description: Reverse-park a full-size bus into a tight terminal bay without clipping the cones.

scenarios.title: Heavy Cargo Handling
scenarios.description: Handle a fully-loaded lorry through winding rural roads without losing control.
